Aisha (PM): Quick sync — putting a lightweight PRD draft in the doc for prompt-level gating + single-step fallback. Need brief eng + ML review before we freeze acceptance criteria. https://tiny.redwood/prd-gating

Ravi (Eng): read. main technical worry: classifier latency and the extra hop if we fallback. want target budget: classifier <=2ms, added routing overhead <10ms.

Nora (ML Eng): agree on <=2ms. propose tiny bag-of-ngrams logistic model with feature set: token_count, avg_token_rank, safety_score (fast heuristics). will validate on chat vs embed sets.

Tomas (SRE): operational constraints: p95 latency for gated requests must remain <=350ms, and we need throttles to prevent fallback-induced hot spots. logging of routing decisions for 30d.

Priya (Solutions): customers require an opt-out for fallback (compliance). add `allow_fallback` per-customer flag. also want response header with chosen model and fallback reason.

Aisha (PM): proposed acceptance criteria:
- Accuracy: gating decisions meet >94% on our eval for safety/quality
- Perf: gated path p95 <=350ms on hosted infra
- Cost: >=12% avg token-cost reduction for gated traffic in baseline workloads
- Reliability: <1% absolute increase in error-rate during 5% canary
- Observability: dashboard w/ gate counts, score histograms, traffic split by model

Ravi (Eng): config sketch: per-customer JSON with keys `allow_fallback`, `fallback_target`, `latency_tier`. sample:
```
{"allow_fallback":true, "fallback_target":"small-v1", "latency_tier":"balanced"}
```

Nora (ML Eng): edge cases: multi-call pipelines (embed -> cross-encoder) must be pinned to same model family; long system prompts should be included in feature calc; tokenization differences can break cache assumptions.

Tomas (SRE): rollout plan:
- dogfood internal tenants
- 5% external canary for 48h with auto-rollback triggers: error-rate +1% or p95 latency +5%
- 25% for 7d if stable
- ramp to 100%

Priya (Solutions): add acceptance test: simulated customer burst (10k concurrent chats) to validate fallback throttles and graceful degradation. include runbook steps for fallback saturation.

Aisha (PM): next steps: Nora + Ravi pair on classifier API and perf targets Mon; Tomas writes rollout playbook; Priya builds customer test harness; I'll update PRD and freeze for eng scoping Thu. Please leave inline comments by Wed EOD. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: CI green for branch `feat/prompt-gate-proto`. preview: https://preview.redwood/prompt-gate

Ravi (Eng): will open prototype PR early next week.

Nora (ML Eng): prepping 300-sample eval set now.

Tomas (SRE): adding alert rules for high fallback rate and model saturation.

Priya (Solutions): drafting sample customer policy docs.

Aisha (PM): thanks — closing the loop.
